verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single release-note line saying users can 'troubleshoot your agentic system with the AI Assistant', which shows a built-in assistant exists in the product. Nothing documents what tasks can be delegated to it or how far its scope extends. The MCP server and natural-language metric feedback are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's capabilities and the tasks it can perform or delegate, evidence it can act on the user's behalf beyond troubleshooting, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
